implementation.uv: deterministic cylindrical parameterisation from appendix FEM rest coordinates
implementation.deformation_binding: UV coordinates are stored per FEM rest node and remain attached during deformation
implementation.sampling: Warp Texture2D bilinear sample at the path-traced hit barycentric UV; U wraps at the seam and V clamps at the ends
implementation.color_space: source sRGB converted to linear RGB before GPU texture sampling
implementation.blend: sampled RGB can be blended with transferred captured vertex colors

runtime_validation.camera: calibrated 1280x720 endoscope plus D405 and overview renders
runtime_validation.result: all three camera images rendered; Warp texture kernel compiled and executed
runtime_validation.focused_tests: 8 passed: texture mapping/provenance and render normals

limitations: This is cylindrical appearance projection, not calibrated camera-to-mesh registration or intrinsic albedo recovery.
The SAM2 candidate region has not been expert-verified as appendix tissue; its source video contains lighting and temporal averaging.
The current FEM surface is coarse and visibly faceted; high-resolution texture sampling does not increase geometry resolution.
The low-sample preview is a functional render check, not a visual realism or clinical validation pass.
privacy: Input video, texture pixels, and rendered frames remain in the ignored local out/ directory; this tracked record stores provenance hashes and aggregate run details only.
